screens.title: The journey starts here

screens.title: A country, ready to explore
screens.description: Public discovery brings destinations, stays, and dining into one starting point.

screens.title: Find somewhere worth going
screens.description: Browse real destination records with category, city, and rating filters.

screens.title: Discover your next stay
screens.description: Hotel discovery surfaces stored descriptions, imagery, and ratings. Reservations are outside this prototype.

screens.title: A taste of the journey
screens.description: Restaurant discovery brings stored dining information and ratings into the travel experience.

screens.title: A trip shaped around you
screens.description: Dates, interests, pace, and budget become the starting point for personalized trip alternatives.

screens.title: A blueprint, ready to refine
screens.description: A genuinely AI-generated saved plan, opened in the actual editor before confirmation and activation.

screens.title: The plan becomes a journey
screens.description: The activated trip connects the itinerary, real place markers, current activities, and progress.

screens.title: The stories behind each stop
screens.description: Actual historical and cultural guidance for the Amman Citadel, generated through the application’s guide service.

screens.title: The next stop, with context
screens.description: A genuine trip-scoped Smart Guide conversation about the next activity, using live operational trip facts.

screens.title: Your journey, within reach
screens.description: The actual activated trip and its progress interface at a mobile viewport.
